title: 第5章 首阳破魔刀第6章 谁说女子不可为帝
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
侯府中。
青石铺就的小径蜿蜒曲折，仿佛灵动的丝带穿梭于繁花盛景之间。
才刚出春，便有名花忍耐不住绽放，争奇斗艳，微风拂过，芬芳馥郁之气弥漫开来，沁人心脾。
夏潜崔梦楼柔夫妇俩猛的停住脚步，回头望着夏辰，语气中难掩惊讶。
“你突破八品境了？”
若是寻常其他人突破八品境，他们俩人眼皮都不会抬一下。
八品境虽称得上不错，特别是夏辰今年才17岁，在外界足以称得上天才了。
但这是侯府，天才众多，抛去嫡系中的几个妖孽之辈，就连旁系中，夏辰这一辈中，也有几个天赋惊人的年轻人冒头。
八品，实在算不上惊人。
可，突破八品之人是夏辰，这足以令人惊奇了。
特别是夏潜夫妇的俩，对夏辰的天赋情况更是知根知底。
这些年，虽然夏辰亲生父母没有从东荒那边送来天材地宝等药物，但夏潜也是给夏辰很多好东西淬炼血肉，打磨体魄。
但这么多年，即便耗费侯府众多资源，也只是勉强让夏辰从不入品，进入九品炼体境。
这让夏潜都不由感慨，武道废体名不虚传。
而现如今，夏辰就突破到第八品了？
“这几天，心有所感，练着练着，不由有些顿悟，从基础刀法中，悟出了一些东西，境界也不知不觉就突破了！”
夏辰如实说道，只是隐去了其中的一些关键，现如今不需要太过多隐藏低调，他必须要快速取得侯府资源支持，从而崛起。
“你施展给我看！”
夏潜听闻之后面色凝重，内心有些惊疑不定，练基础刀法进入了顿悟之中？
他们侯府的基础刀法自然不是普通最低等的刀法，而是他们600年一代代钻研，甚至参考过皇家最强九品刀法，最终领悟出了这种最适合九品炼体境的刀法。

对打磨体魄最有效益，因其最适合第九品武夫锻体，因而这才取名为基础刀法。
这款基础刀法早就已经到了进无可进，改无可改进的地步，即便是他当年，学习的也是这基础刀法。
而现在，夏辰竟然说，他在这款刀法中领悟出了一些新的东西。
年轻时，夏潜也曾心高气傲，想着为家族做出贡献，改进这款刀法，但直到他现如今的境界，也依旧没有试图去改进这款刀法。
不仅是他，夏辰的亲生父亲夏渊，还有他们的父亲，侯府真正的主人，镇东侯夏楚天都没能做到。
“拿刀！”
夏辰对身边随从说道。
“直接用我这把！”
夏潜二话不说，直接从他的身侧抽出一柄冒着惊人寒光，通体幽黑的长刀。
这柄长刀出世的那一刻，夏辰眸子中仿佛看到一条黑蛟从深渊中一跃而出，幽冷的鳞片，仿佛能吞噬人心。
这种异象仅一闪而过，那柄黝黑长刀很快归为平静，夏辰知道，刚才那一幕并非错觉，这是一柄神兵，那一头黑蛟最少也是三品大妖，这边黝黑长刀，沐浴三品之上大妖精血诞生，刀身内甚至镇压了大妖之魂。
这是侯府底蕴之一。
夏辰双手紧握长刀，但即便如此也感觉双手一沉，这一柄黝黑长刀即便已经收敛了神异，但仅刀身，也依旧奇重无比，如果是之前还只是九品镜的他，最多能够勉强抓起，但根本挥舞不动。
这柄长刀，本身就是一种考验，考验他的境界水平。
content_en:
In the Hou Mansion.
The paths paved with bluestones are winding and winding, like flexible ribbons weaving through the blooming flowers.
Spring has just begun, and famous flowers can't help but bloom. The breeze blows, and the fragrance spreads, refreshing the heart and mind.
Xia Qian, Cui Menglou and his wife suddenly stopped and looked back at Xia Chen, unable to conceal their surprise in their voices.
"Have you broken through to the eighth level?"
If other people were to break through to the eighth level, neither of them would even raise their eyelids.
Although the eighth-level realm is considered good, especially since Xia Chen is only 17 years old this year, he is considered a genius in the outside world.
But this is the Hou Mansion, and there are many geniuses. Apart from the few monsters in the direct line, there are also several young people with amazing talents in Xia Chen's generation in the side line.
Eighth grade is really not amazing.
However, the person who broke through to the eighth level was Xia Chen, which was surprising enough.
In particular, Xia Qian and his wife knew Xia Chen's talent well.
In recent years, although Xia Chen's biological parents did not send any medicines such as heavenly materials and earthly treasures from Donghuang, Xia Qian also gave Xia Chen many good things to temper his flesh and blood and polish his body.
But after so many years, even after spending a lot of resources in the Hou Mansion, Xia Chen was barely able to enter the ninth-level body refining realm.
This made Xia Qian couldn't help but sigh, the martial arts waste body lived up to its reputation.
And now, Xia Chen has broken through to the eighth level?
"In the past few days, I have felt something in my heart. As I continued to practice, I couldn't help but have some epiphanies. I realized something from the basic sword skills, and I made a breakthrough without knowing it!"
Xia Chen told the truth, but hid some of the key points. Now there is no need to hide too much and keep a low profile. He must quickly obtain the support of the Hou Mansion's resources to rise.
"Show it to me!"
After hearing this, Xia Qian's face became solemn, and he was a little surprised and confused. Did he practice basic sword skills and enter an epiphany?
The basic swordsmanship of their Hou Mansion is naturally not the lowest common swordsmanship, but they have been studying it for 600 years, and even consulted the royal family's strongest ninth-grade swordsmanship, and finally understood this swordsmanship that is most suitable for the ninth-grade body refining realm.
It is most effective in polishing the body, because it is most suitable for ninth-grade warriors to strengthen their bodies, so this is named the basic sword technique.
This basic sword technique has long reached the point where there is no progress or improvement. Even back then, he was still learning this basic sword technique.
And now, Xia Chen actually said that he had learned something new in this sword technique.
When he was young, Xia Qian was arrogant and wanted to contribute to the family and improve this sword technique, but until his current state, he still did not try to improve this sword technique.
Not only him, Xia Chen's biological father Xia Yuan, but also their father, the real owner of the Hou Mansion, Zhendong Hou Xia Chutian, failed to do it.
"Get the knife!"
Xia Chen said to his followers.
"Just use this one!"
Without saying a word, Xia Qian pulled out a long knife from his side that emitted an astonishing cold light and was completely black.
The moment this long knife was born, Xia Chen's eyes seemed to see a black dragon leaping out of the abyss. Its cold scales seemed to be able to swallow people's hearts.
This vision only flashed past, and the dark long sword quickly returned to calm. Xia Chen knew that the scene just now was not an illusion. It was a magic weapon. The black dragon was at least a third-level demon. The long black sword was born after bathing in the blood of a third-level demon. The soul of the demon was even suppressed in the blade.
This is one of the foundations of the Hou Mansion.
Xia Chen held the long knife tightly with both hands, but even so, he felt his hands sink. Even though the dark long knife had restrained its magic, the blade alone was still extremely heavy. If he was just a ninth-grade mirror before, he could barely grab it at most, but he couldn't swing it at all.
This long sword is a test in itself, testing his level of realm.
